findings.issue: Task 11 has wave: 4 and depends_on: [10], but Task 10 is also in wave: 4. Per validator rule (Decomposition Quality / Dependency correctness): a task with depends_on: [X] must have wave > wave of X. With both tasks in the same wave, the orchestrator can spawn them in parallel and Task 11 may start before Task 10 (deploy) finishes — Task 11 explicitly requires the deploy timestamp from Task 10 (Step 1: '--since <deploy timestamp>') and the one-time SQL cleanup applied during Task 10 (Step 2: failed_articles count). Running them concurrently breaks the verification semantics.
findings.fix: Bump Task 11's wave to 5 (so it strictly follows Task 10's wave 4). Note: Task 9 (pre-deploy QA, wave 4) and Task 10 (deploy, wave 4, depends_on [9]) appear to have the same issue but are out of scope for this batch — flag separately if they also violate the rule. For Task 11 alone: change `wave: 4` to `wave: 5` in the frontmatter.
